name: openauth-template
description: Deploy an OpenAuth server on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply AUTH_DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv namespace create AUTH_STORAGE --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.db:tables: wrangler d1 execute AUTH_DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
scripts.db:users: wrangler d1 execute AUTH_DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.json --command "SELECT * FROM user LIMIT 10;"
scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run kv:create && npm run secrets:set
scripts.setup:secrets: echo 'Setting up secrets...' && wrangler secret put GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID --config wrangler.deploy.json && wrangler secret put GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET --config wrangler.deploy.json
